"''You're inside my mind.|The contact pretends to fall victim to Haja Estree's fake mind trick|{{Kenobi|Part II}}}} A [[Gender|male]] individual who worked at a [[Daiyu spaceport|spaceport]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]] was a '''contact''' for the [[con artist]] [[Haja Estree]]. In [[9 BBY]],{{KenobiDate|II}} they collaborated with Estree as part of a scam in which the con-man pretended to use a [[Jedi]] [[mind trick]] on the contact, who then allowed Estree's clients safe passage off-world. The contact allowed the [[Youngling|young]] boy [[Corran]] and his [[Parent|mother]], [[Nyche]],''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' to pass through [[Gate 3-C]] at the [[spaceport]], which was operated by the contact. ==Behind the scenes== The voice of Haja Estree's contact first appeared in "[[Part II]]" of the live-action limited series ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'', and released on [[May 26]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''|date=2022-05-26|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early.
